WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT f.week_ending_date, sum(f.closing_value) AS chain_stock_value
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar c ON f.week_ending_date BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id < 900
    AND c.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND c.fiscal_period = 3
  GROUP BY f.week_ending_date)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category, round(avg(chain_stock_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_at_cost_eur, count(*) AS weeks FROM weekly
